shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving of schematic motifs on stone surface
grouping of small motifs across a broad flat field
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic, shallow-relief motifs including discs/rings and curved arcs distributed over a broad flat field, rendered as simple outlined shapes without interior detail. Otherwise the content is quite different: A shows repeated animal-like creatures in profile arranged in horizontal registers, while B is a single anthropomorphic figure with head, torso and arms whose motifs (rings, crescent, banded elements) are organised around the body rather than in a register scheme.
